tool_args.rationale: The prior attempt failed due solely to an undefined training-row global inside predict, not failed scientific confirmation. This revision stores fitted parameters when fit(train_rows) runs and has predict use that state, while fitting all four ODE parameters and deriving z_t0 from irregular, time-shifted raw prefixes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight trajectories now meet the authorized minimum for fitting the four coupled-ODE parameters; another probe is not needed before attempting the repaired model.
Already acquired and supplied eight rows, so repeating it adds cost without resolving an outstanding identifiability gap.
Endpoint-matched history-gap and coupled-transient-lag signatures, together with horizon-dependent outputs, favor the explicitly authorized memory ODE over a simple snapshot law.
The observed transient lag is evidence that the fast memory state matters; fitting the full authorized system is better supported.
